verifications.claim: LIV Golf is not shutting down immediately.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: LIV Golf CEO Scott O’Neil... 2026 season is continuing “exactly as planned, uninterrupted and at full throttle.” (R1); "Our season continues exactly as planned, uninterrupted and at full throttle." (R2); LIV Golf's CEO released an internal memo stating the league is proceeding with its 2026 schedule (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly quote or paraphrase the CEO's assurance that the current 2026 season continues uninterrupted, denying immediate shutdown amid rumors.

verifications.claim: Scott O'Neil is LIV Golf's CEO.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: LIV Golf CEO Scott O’Neil (R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, R8, R10)
verifications.reasoning: Every relevant source explicitly identifies Scott O'Neil as LIV Golf's CEO.

verifications.claim: Scott O'Neil assured staff in an April 2026 memo that LIV Golf's 2026 season will continue "at full throttle" with all scheduled events proceeding as planned.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: writing in an email to staff... 2026 season is continuing “exactly as planned, uninterrupted and at full throttle.” (R1); in a Wednesday email to LIV Golf staff... "Our season continues exactly as planned, uninterrupted and at full throttle." (R2); internal memo... proceeding with its 2026 schedule... "at full throttle" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm the April 2026 email/memo to staff with near-exact phrasing about the 2026 season continuing 'at full throttle' and as planned.

verifications.claim: LIV Golf is proceeding with its 2026 schedule.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: the 2026 season is continuing “exactly as planned" (R1); the tour's 2026 season will continue "exactly as planned." (R2); the league is proceeding with its 2026 schedule (R3)
verifications.reasoning: CEO's memo and ongoing events like Mexico City directly support proceeding with the full 2026 schedule.

verifications.claim: LIV Golf's 2026 schedule includes events in Mexico City.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: LIV Golf’s Mexico City event (R1); LIV Golf Mexico tournament (R2); LIV Golf Mexico City at Club de Golf Chapultepec (R4, R5, R9); LIV Mexico event (R6, R7, R8)
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm the ongoing LIV Golf Mexico City event as part of the 2026 season schedule.

verifications.claim: LIV Golf has strongly denied rumors of an immediate shutdown.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Scott O’Neil attempted to shut down talk of his company’s rumored downfall (R1); LIV Golf CEO says 2026 season will go on (R2); CEO released an internal memo... amid the swirling rumors (R3); CEO Scott O'Neil assured employees... rumors that the circuit might be closing (R4); LIV Golf officials refuted the rumors (R5)
verifications.reasoning: CEO's email, announcers, and official statements directly and strongly deny immediate shutdown rumors.

verifications.claim: Reports suggest that LIV Golf's 2026 season is safe.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: LIV Golf's 2026 season will proceed as scheduled... full backing of... PIF (R5, Reuters in R5); sources... said funding would continue and the remaining nine tournaments... would go ahead as planned (R5); CEO... season will continue (R2, R4, R6, R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple reports, including Reuters and CEO statements, confirm the 2026 season is funded and safe.

verifications.claim: Reports suggest that Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) is re-evaluating its investments of over $5 billion.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Saudi Public Investment Fund's total investment in LIV Golf had reached $5.3 billion (R2); commitment has surpassed $5.3 billion (R3, R5); PIF's overall investment in LIV was reportedly approaching $5bn (R6); received more than $5 billion from the PIF (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Sources report PIF's $5+ billion investment in LIV and ongoing re-evaluation or potential cuts.

verifications.claim: Reports suggest that the PIF is re-evaluating its investments due to low viewership and low return on investment.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: throwing money at a product without a return on investment... struggled to gain viewership (R3); has a limit when it comes to throwing money at a product without a return on investment (R5); pressure... sustainable and bring a return... low viewership implied in losses (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Reports explicitly link PIF re-evaluation to lack of ROI and low US viewership.

verifications.claim: Scott O'Neil stated, "Our season continues exactly as planned, uninterrupted and at full throttle".
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Our season continues exactly as planned, uninterrupted and at full throttle." (R1, R2 exact or near-exact); similar phrasing throughout (R3, R6, R7, R8)
verifications.reasoning: Direct quote from CEO's email appears verbatim or nearly so in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: Jon Rahm is currently locked into LIV Golf's 2026 season.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: attracting the likes of... Jon Rahm (R1); LIV Golf roster... Jon Rahm (R2); made... Jon Rahm rich (still implied current, R3); Jon Rahm... leading... LIV Golf Mexico City (R5); Rahm... declined [PGA return] (R7); biggest stars under contract... Jon Rahm (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Rahm is still actively playing in 2026 events and on roster/under contract, but do not explicitly state 'locked into 2026 season'; implied by participation and declined returns.

verifications.claim: Bryson DeChambeau is currently locked into LIV Golf's 2026 season.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: attracting the likes of Bryson DeChambeau (R1); LIV Golf roster... Bryson DeChambeau (R2); made... Bryson DeChambeau rich (R3); big stars Bryson DeChambeau (R5); DeChambeau... declined [PGA return] (R7); biggest stars under contract... Bryson DeChambeau (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm DeChambeau is still with LIV, on roster, playing 2026, declined returns, but no explicit 'locked into 2026 season'; supported broadly.

verifications.claim: Official communications confirm that LIV Golf's 2026 season will continue.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: email to staff that the 2026 season is continuing “exactly as planned (R1); email to LIV Golf staff... 2026 season will continue "exactly as planned" (R2); internal memo stating the league is proceeding (R3); message from CEO Scott O'Neil... 2026 season "continues exactly as planned (R4); LIV Golf posted... "We are ON." (R5)
verifications.reasoning: CEO's email and official social media posts are official communications confirming 2026 season continuation.
